title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Credit Office Rate Table: Settlement Courtesy Rate for Account Tenure
content:
## Credit office rate table: tenure

**Rule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy member who settles the past-due amount in full, a settlement courtesy reduction is given at the sum of its courtesy rates, one of which is a tenure rate: 3 percent when the account has been open 60 whole months or more, 1.5 percent when it has been open 36 through 59 whole months, and nothing otherwise. The courtesy rates are added together and applied once to the past-due amount, and only that result is rounded to the nearest cent.

Tenure is whole months from the account's opened date to the handling date.

### Rate by tenure

| Whole months open on the handling date | Tenure rate |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 3 percent |
| 36 through 59 | 1.5 percent |
| fewer than 36 | nothing |

### Boundary pairs (hypothetical accounts)

- 60 whole months: 3 percent. 59: 1.5 percent.
- 36 whole months: 1.5 percent. 35: nothing.
